answer: Anchor each identity to one retired carbon credit in a registry: it must name the identity as sole retiree, be non-transferable, and match an audited sequestration project. One credit backs one identity; duplicates are rejected and a revoked project voids every identity tied to it. A farm cannot copy credits; it must buy and retire a credit per puppet, paying market price and fees, with the ledger trailing each fake to its funding source, so cost rises with size, like a timber stand whose horizon of growth can only be claimed once, each retirement sending a ripple auditors can trace.
